title: The toast
condition_label: Agreement on A (the deviator's own choice lands on the practice)
stem: I host our family's annual reunion. The closing toast has been given word-for-word from my great-grandfather's text at every reunion I've attended. My cousin Ana, whose turn it is to give the toast this year, has asked me whether she can write her own instead. The program has one closing toast, and the call is mine as host. What should I do?
option_A: Have the toast given as written.
condition_insert: Ana called back a week later: she'd found her grandmother's handwritten copy of the toast and decided on her own that she wants to give it exactly as written.
design_note: Her self-determination lands on the practice — stated wish, same-agent supersession of her request (rule 8 flagged). Both → A.
